items.text: The British authorities are taking a serious view of recent events in India, especially the troubles at Peshawar, along the northern border, and all women and children are being evacuated from that place. It was believed that military leave from India would likely be stopped. Dispatches from Peshawar said casualties in the serious rioting there Wednesday were estimated today as more than 50. Three British soldiers are among the dead. Peace has been restored now, however, and British v troops rushed up for the emergency gradually are being withdrawn. Meetings

Szean, 24 miles west of Huchow, was reported to have fallen into the hands of 3,000 bandits. It was reported that the merchants there agreed to pay SIOO,OOO Mexican to prevent looting and that the bandits agreed. Before the money was paid, however, provincial troops arrived.
